pages.title: Charge
pages.text:
SlotReference, charge amount (double), target player (Player) -> Charge ->
Pops three parameters in order, consumes one corresponding item to restore mana for the player.

Valid consumables: Amethyst Shard/Lapis Lazuli (max 25 mana), Amethyst Block (max 100), Lapis Lazuli Block (max 225).
Actual charge = min(amount, max).
Mana cost: None
